name: Ajna V2
rootCause: liquidation accounting manipulation via self-controlled auction. Lost: ~$124.8K for this cbETH pool (1 of 7 pools hit by the same bug the same day, ~$775K aggregate)

descriptions.text: liquidation accounting manipulation via self-controlled auction. Lost: ~$124.8K for this cbETH pool (1 of 7 pools hit by the same bug the same day, ~$775K aggregate)

Ajna V2 suffered a reported $775,400 loss on Ethereum on 2026-08-28 after attackers exploited its liquidation accounting across multiple pools. One checked cbETH transaction shows 3.474032198249838476 WETH sent into the reported pool path and 48.127374524782420835 cbETH leaving before the 4 WETH funding leg was repaid. Available evidence supports a flaw in Ajna V2's internal liquidation lifecycle. Public reconstructions place the exploitable sequence in the interaction of bucketTake, collateral removal, take, and settlement, allowing collateral to leave a pool without matching quote repayment.
